name: FBM Sphere Tracing with Implicit BVH
aliases: Dynamic Bounding Volume Hierarchy for FBM
definition: A method to accelerate sphere tracing of FBM-based noise by treating cascaded sums (octaves) as nested bounding volumes. It progressively evaluates octaves while bounding the remaining sum to determine if the total function value can exceed a threshold, allowing empty space skipping with reduced computational cost.
summary: FBM Sphere Tracing with Implicit BVH accelerates volume rendering by using the FBM octave structure as a dynamic hierarchy to skip empty space, avoiding explicit tree storage.
